mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes sodium and potassium depletion which may be exacerbated by testosterone's androgenic effects on fluid and electrolyte balance, and testosterone may increase cardiac workload while thiazide diuretics affect fluid status.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly and blood pressure; assess for signs of hypokalemia; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent if needed.
